title: Compare Story Problems
sourceStudentTask: Original How Many Rides? Student Facing: WRITE and ANSWER TWO distinct original questions using Diego 7, Priya 11, Jada 3, Kiran 6 and Noah 9 ride counts

teacherRubric.required: Learner authors TWO intelligible mathematically answerable questions; cannot merely repeat two auto-generated answers.
Use only appropriate listed real source-table ride data: Diego 7, Priya 11, Jada 3, Kiran 6 or Noah 9; no unsupported source claims.
Question coherently asks a comparison, part-part-whole, or other first-grade-appropriate relation with clear known quantities.
Each self-created question has a correct equation, a mathematically verified solution and the unit 'rides'. For a how-many-more/fewer question, find the DIFFERENCE, not the sum.
Review is a first-party rubric prepared for possible future real pupil work; no teacher/child class activity or signoff is claimed before it occurs.

note: No new approval threshold: existing original V1 source/task fidelity with honest teacher-only boundary; numeric Practice provides partial skill assessment.
